chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a very thin, tall Moroccan man of 33 with short receding black hair and a light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark grey joggers
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman in her mid-20s wearing a lilac satin headscarf and a long dusty-pink house djellaba with white embroidery on the chest
